entities.summary: Kraft, 9th Prince of Hohenlohe-Langenburg, was a German prince and landowner who was titular head of the House of Hohenlohe-Langenburg. He was a nephew of Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh, a nephew-in-law of Queen Elizabeth II, and thus a first cousin of King Charles III.
